## Hello!

I'm an environmental scientist interested in how we can make the best land management decisions possible for soil carbon sequestration, climate resilience, and ecosystem function. My research focuses on ecological impacts of solar energy and the effects of integrating regenerative grazing to reduce land-use tension between energy and agriculture and improve the environmental outcomes of renewable energy. I received my PhD from Colorado State University in Soil Science, and I'm currently a postdoctoral research fellow working with [Dr. Keith Paustian](https://agsci.colostate.edu/old-soilcrop/faculty/keith-paustian/). Before grad school, I spect several years at the Environmental Defense Fund working on clean air and climate policy, which still sthapes how I think about making research useful to decision-makers. When I'm not in the field or the lab, I'm usually trail running, backpacking, or playing in the mountains.
